title: Kicked Spicy Tunisian Rye Bread Flatbread
description: A spicy and snappy Tunisian dish featuring rye bread, nuka-pickle, and lacto-vegetarian-friendly ingredients, perfect for a energizing snack.
instructions: Combine rye flour, sugar, salt, and yeast in a large mixing bowl.
Add olive oil, harissa, and nuka-pickle to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Gradually add warm water to the dough and knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and cook the flatbreads for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Brush the flatbreads with additional olive oil and serve hot.
